sentiment.rationale: Forward guidance was reduced: full-year adjusted EPS guidance was narrowed to the bottom half of the prior range ($7.00-$8.00 vs. prior $7.00-$8.00 but described as 'bottom half of the prior range'), and Q4 comparable sales guidance is for a low-single-digit decline, unchanged from prior but still negative. Management explicitly states they are 'far from satisfied' and that the business 'has not been performing up to its potential.' The tone is cautious and defensive, with no positive inflection in forward expectations.

summary.revenue: Q3 net sales were $25.3 billion, 1.5% lower than 2024. Comparable sales decreased 2.7%.
summary.eps: Q3 GAAP EPS was $1.51 vs. $1.85 last year. Adjusted EPS was $1.78, about 4% lower than a year ago.
summary.guidance: Full-year adjusted EPS guidance narrowed to $7.00-$8.00 (bottom half of prior range). Q4 comparable sales expected to decline low-single digits. 2026 CapEx expected to increase by ~$1 billion to $5 billion.
summary.margin: Q3 gross margin rate was 28.2%, about 10 bps lower than last year. Operating income margin rate was 3.8% (GAAP) or 4.4% (adjusted).
key_risks: Continued softness in discretionary categories like Home and Apparel
Consumer sentiment at a three-year low amid concerns about jobs, affordability, and tariffs
Volatility in weekly and monthly sales trends
September sales hampered by unusually warm weather
key_opportunities: Fun 101 (Hardlines) delivered growth, led by nearly 10% comp in toys
Food & Beverage delivered comp growth, with beverages up nearly 7%
Same-day delivery powered by Target Circle 360 grew more than 35%
Target Plus marketplace GMV grew nearly 50%
Planned $5 billion CapEx in 2026 for new stores, remodels, and technology
AI-enabled tools like Target Trend Brain and synthetic audiences to accelerate trend identification
Expansion of next-day shipping to more than half of US population
